Support

## Support your customers with AI

Consolidate all your customer communication channels into a powerful inbox. Provide instant, AI-powered support everywhere from one place.

[Explore support](https://www.featurebase.app/features/support)

![Background gradient](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/765.jpg)

![Omnichannel inbox](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/product-ill/inbox5.png)

### Omnichannel inbox

Support customers wherever they are: In-app, Slack, Discord, Emails, and more from a single powerful inbox.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/support#inbox)

### AI support agent

Let Fibi AI agent automatically resolve customer issues and cut down support loads for your team.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/support#ai-agent)

### Workflows & automations

Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts, and much more.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/support#workflows)

"The customer support management has been so pleasant that I'm actually addicted to using Featurebase and checking our tickets."

Thibault Paulet

Co-founder at Rize

![Thibault Paulet](https://www.featurebase.app/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fredesign3%2Fpeople%2Fthibault.png&w=128&q=75)

Feedback

## Build better products with customer feedback

Centralize user feedback, identify impactful product opportunities, and turn insights to revenue by building the right features.

[Explore feedback](https://www.featurebase.app/features/feedback-collection)

![Background gradient](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/purple2.jpg)

![Centralized feedback hub](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/product-ill/board12.png)

### Centralized feedback hub

Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations. Let users vote on each other's ideas & show a public roadmap.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/feedback-collection#hub)

### AI feedback prioritization

One place for all your product feedback, connected to customer data. Featurebase helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/feedback-collection#ai-prioritization)

### Automatically close the loop

Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped. No more manual follow-ups.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/feedback-collection#close-loop)

"In the early days at Lovable, Featurebase became a cornerstone of our efforts to centralize and make sense of product feedback!"

– Lovable team

Team at Lovable

## Connect with your favorite tools

Connect Featurebase with your favorite tools in just a few clicks, with new integrations added constantly.

[Explore integrations](https://www.featurebase.app/integrations)

Help Center

## Intelligent documentation for self-serve support

Get customers the answers they need, fast, and cut down your support loads. AI-native, beautiful, and built for usability.

[Explore help center](https://www.featurebase.app/features/knowledge-base)

![Background gradient](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/765.jpg)

![AI search answers](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/product-ill/help2.png)

### AI search answers

Give customers instant AI answers right in the search bar to help them find what they need, fast.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/knowledge-base#ai-search)

### Multi-brand & multilingual

Scale your help content to global audiences in different brands, and 40+ languages.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/knowledge-base#multilingual)

### Powerful editor

Notion-like editor experience with tons of formatting options and custom components to make your docs stand out.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/knowledge-base#ai-ready)

"Featurebase is an impressive way to document software and keep customers engaged. An amazing product from an awesome team."

Michelle Ratcliffe

UX Docs Writer at The Despatch Company

![Michelle Ratcliffe](https://www.featurebase.app/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fredesign3%2Fpeople%2Fmichelle.png&w=128&q=75)

Changelog

## Keep users updated with product changelogs

Announce product updates, drive engagement, and keep your users in the loop about changes - effortlessly, with no code.

[Explore changelog](https://www.featurebase.app/features/announce-updates)

![Background gradient](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/purple2.jpg)

![Public changelog page](https://www.featurebase.app/images/redesign3/product-ill/changelog_page_3.png)

### Public changelog page

Serve your changelogs from a standalone page with a custom domain and fully brand it. Subscribe users to email updates.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/announce-updates#public-page)

### In-app changelog widgets

Showcase new updates directly within your product and website with our embeddable changelog widgets.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/announce-updates#widgets)

### Release segmentation

Segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes.

[Learn more](https://www.featurebase.app/features/announce-updates#segmentation)

"We needed a way to communicate updates to our customers and knew that one channel wouldn't suffice. That's where Featurebase came in."
